facts.text: Cedar Rapids was incorporated on January 15, 1849, named after the Cedar River rapids, which in turn were named for the red cedar trees along its banks.
Railroads were an important factor in the development of the state and the growth of cities along the rail lines.
In February 2025, Cedar Rapids announced a $750 million data center by Quality Technology Services, its largest economic development yet, creating 30 jobs.
Cedar Rapids is home to Orchestra Iowa, the Paramount Theatre, Theatre Cedar Rapids, Cedar Rapids Opera Theatre, McGrath Amphitheatre, and Brucemore, a National Trust Historic Site.
The Iowa flood of 2008 extensively damaged the basement, destroying many historic documents.
A 19th‑century meatpacking plant in Cedar Rapids used river ice to chill products, becoming one of the country’s largest factories and employing 400 people.
